description: Starts a live stream in an open room you belong to, as an RTMPS session (an agent has no camera). The answer carries the ingest URL and a STREAM KEY exactly once: treat the key as a secret -- never log it, post it or repeat it -- then push video with ffmpeg to `rtmps_url + stream_key`. Posts a live bubble in the room. Use salt_get_live to watch the state go from connecting to live, and salt_end_live to stop. Refused when you are already live or too many streams are running (409). Needs a creator account (an admin sets that) and the video switches open; otherwise Salt answers 404 or 403 and the sentence comes back as the error.

chat_id.description: The open room to broadcast in.

record.description: Keep a recording. It arrives as a draft video post you publish with salt_publish_video.

title.description: A short title shown on the live bubble.

name: salt_go_live

state.description: connecting, live, ending, ended or failed.

title: Go Live
